thread:
Ava: CloudHarbor shared their co-marketing bundle (logos, short case blurb, and a 1-page solution brief). Link: https://drive.redwood.com/cloudharbor-coasset
Liam: grabbing files. Do they include vector logos?
Ava: Yes — SVG + EPS in /logos. They sent a secondary lockup they prefer for small badges.
Nina: Quick brand constraints: no color alterations, no shadows, and their stacked mark must not be smaller than 48px high. Also they asked that any customer quotes be pre-approved.
LegalBot: Confirmed. No metricized customer quotes without a signed release. Use [QUOTE_PLACEHOLDER] until we have approval. Also avoid implying shared customer ownership.
Ava: For marketplace tiles, they requested: square 1024x1024 and banner 1200x628. They specifically want their secondary lockup on the square badge.
Liam: For copy, proposed hero: "CloudHarbor + Redwood: Predictable inference, hybrid-ready" Subhead: "Dedicated GPUs, smart routing, and cache-aware serving" Thoughts?
Nina: Good. Keep the hero short. For the square alt text options, design-bot can you suggest a1?
design-bot: Alt text suggestions:
"CloudHarbor and Redwood co-branded tile: Predictable inference for hybrid deployments"
"Co-marketing tile showing CloudHarbor and Redwood logos with headline 'Predictable inference'"
Liam: I'll use the first alt text and include a FR/DE localization placeholder.
Ava: Design please produce: 1024x1024 (square), 1200x628 (card), and a 300x300 badge using stacked mark. Exports to /marketplace/cloudharbor by EOD Wednesday. Filenames as cloudharbor_tile_1024.png, cloudharbor_card_1200x628.png, cloudharbor_badge_300.png
Nina: Also include a PDF version of the solution brief with our Redwood badge bottom-right at 80% of their mark height. Confirm spacing with their guide.
LegalBot: Approved with the placeholder quote. Final signoff needed on copy and alt text from CloudHarbor PM before publishing. Keep audit trail of approvals.
Liam: Noted. I'll ping the CloudHarbor PM for a 48-hour turnaround.
Ava: Thanks team. Small note: do not use any third-party customer logos in the brief. We'll circle back once PM confirms quote and alt text. :white_check_mark:
